title: Cursor Now Belongs to SpaceX
caption:
I never once thought about who owned my editor.

Now it's SpaceX. $60B, all stock, closed August 14. Same price, same models, same everything on day one. What changed is upstream: Cursor's team works on Grok now, and Grok 4.5 was already trained on trillions of tokens of Cursor session data.

I'm not switching. I did finally read the terms.

Whose editor do you trust?

slides.title: Trained on your edits

slides.title: What actually changed
items: The team: Cursor's engineers now work on Grok, not just the editor
The price: unchanged. Free, $20, $60 and $200 tiers all still stand
The models: unchanged. Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-5.6 and Gemini still route
The roadmap: nothing announced since the deal closed on August 14
